## Batch 84 handoff

All 12 assigned items are drafted across the A/B pages. **Seven are marked ready and five escalated.** The escalations are LM-dependent: batch 72’s `def-trust-region-quadratic-model-and-ratio` and `lem-positive-definite-model-has-unique-newton-step` bodies were inspected, but both lack current Step 1 readiness records.

The scoped checks pass: 40 proof steps with no layout defects; 12/12 strict proof contracts; 31 harvested results with no coverage errors; 4/4 source entries fetch-verified; and no errors in the focused dependency, provenance, forward-reference, rendering, precheck, or citation-fidelity checks. All 12 readiness-record hashes match.

Two run-wide blockers are outside batch 84: the item-level dependency check reports 22 empty inventories and one stale level, and run-wide readiness parsing stops on duplicate `pipeline_run` metadata in a foreign item. The batch-level dependency check also stops on malformed YAML in a foreign item. Details are recorded in the notes. These records indicate authoring readiness, not independent proof approval or publication.
